request_zh: 写给小满：在Solmere过得很开心。用暖色、自然纸边和这里的照片，让她收到一点我的新生活。
request_en: For Xiaoman: life in Solmere has been happy. Warm colours, natural paper edges and these photos will bring her a little of my new life.
reply_zh: 小满说，她把信放在书桌旁，像是跟着照片到Solmere走了一圈。
reply_en: Xiaoman put the letter by her desk. She said the photos felt like a little walk through Solmere.
answers_zh: 她喜欢奶油色、浅蓝色和植物，也喜欢留着毛边的纸。她说太整齐了，反而舍不得碰。
我们总约在车站旁喝东西。她会先把杯垫翻过来画几笔，等我到了才把菜单递给我。
answers_en: She likes cream, pale blue, plants and torn paper edges. Anything too perfect makes her afraid to touch it.
We used to meet by the station. She would doodle on the back of a coaster while waiting, then slide the menu over when I arrived.

dialogue_zh.speaker: npc
dialogue_zh.text: 你好，可以请你帮我做一封拼贴信吗？

dialogue_zh.speaker: player
dialogue_zh.text: 好的，想把什么心情寄给对方呢？

dialogue_zh.speaker: npc
dialogue_zh.text: 我来到Solmere已经有一段时间了，以前总是和朋友用手机聊天。她最近迷上了拼贴，我想把开心的日子用她喜欢的方式寄给她。她叫小满。

dialogue_zh.speaker: npc
dialogue_zh.text: 她上次寄我的信，连咖啡杯垫都贴进去了。我一直放在抽屉最上面。我的字写起来太像工作汇报了，想请你帮我也留下一点生活的样子。

dialogue_zh.speaker: npc
dialogue_zh.text: 这两张照片，一张是我等车时常坐的长椅，另一张是街角饭店。你看，柜子上还有一碗柠檬。坐在那里吃午饭，抬头就能看见海。我想让小满知道，我在这里过得很开心。

dialogue_zh.speaker: player
dialogue_zh.text: 好的，我会把这些心意放进信里，做好后帮您寄出。

dialogue_zh.speaker: npc
dialogue_zh.text: 好的，麻烦您了。慢慢来，我很期待。

dialogue_en.speaker: npc
dialogue_en.text: Hello. Could you help me make a collage letter?
dialogue_en.reply: Of course. Tell me about it.

dialogue_en.speaker: player
dialogue_en.text: Of course. What would you like the letter to say?

dialogue_en.speaker: npc
dialogue_en.text: I have lived in Solmere for a while. My friend and I usually chat on our phones. She has taken up collage, so I want to send my happy days in a way she enjoys. Her name is Xiaoman.

dialogue_en.speaker: npc
dialogue_en.text: Her last letter had a coffee coaster pasted into it. I keep it in the top drawer. My own writing sounds like a report; could you help me leave a little everyday life on the page?

dialogue_en.speaker: npc
dialogue_en.text: One photo shows the bench where I wait for the bus; the other is the corner restaurant. There is a bowl of lemons on the cabinet. When I have lunch there, I can look up and see the sea. I want Xiaoman to know I am happy here.
dialogue_en.reply: I will post it for you when it is ready.

dialogue_en.speaker: player
dialogue_en.text: I will put that feeling into the letter, then post it for you.

dialogue_en.speaker: npc
dialogue_en.text: Thank you. Take your time; I look forward to it.

request_zh: 给搬来的新邻居一张欢迎信。用暖色，留一点能写地址的空白。
request_en: Welcome a new neighbor with warm colors. Leave room to write an address.
reply_zh: 她把欢迎信放在了早餐篮里，连同两只面包一起送过去。
reply_en: The welcome note went into a breakfast basket with two warm rolls.
answers_zh: 他家窗台上摆着黄色的小花。也许用暖色的纸，再留一块能写地址的空白，就很合适。
搬家那天，他把梯子借给了我们，我们才终于挂好门口的招牌。明早想给他送两只面包。
answers_en: He keeps yellow flowers on his windowsill. Warm paper and a clear space for the address would suit him.
He lent us a ladder on moving day so we could hang the shop sign. Tomorrow I want to leave two fresh rolls at his door.

request_zh: 写给第一次出海的学徒。要有海的颜色，不要写一路顺风。
request_en: For a new sailor. Use sea colors, but avoid the usual good-luck phrases.
reply_zh: 学徒把这张信贴在了储物柜门里。
reply_en: The apprentice tucked your letter inside the locker door.
answers_zh: 她喜欢海蓝和旧地图，不喜欢把所有东西都摆正。像风刚吹过桌面那样就好。
她第一次值夜班，带了一大壶热茶，却忘了拿杯子。我们最后用两个洗干净的果酱瓶喝完了。
answers_en: She likes sea blue, old maps and arrangements that look as if a breeze just passed over the desk.
On her first night shift she brought a huge flask of tea and no cups. We drank it from two clean jam jars.

request_en: Thank a retiring gardener. Include plants; avoid age and grand speeches.
reply_zh: 园丁笑着说，明年还会回来看看那棵树。
reply_en: The gardener smiled and promised to visit the tree next year.
answers_zh: 他会把掉下来的叶子夹进书里。植物剪影和带纤维的纸就好，字不要太满。
以前他总把多种的一小盆薄荷放在花店门口。现在窗边那一排，全是从他那盆分出来的。
answers_en: He presses fallen leaves in books. Plant silhouettes, fibrous paper and plenty of space would be lovely.
He used to leave spare mint plants outside our shop. Every pot on our windowsill came from that first one.

request_en: A keepsake for a friend who missed the show. Add a music scrap and a ticket.
reply_zh: 他认出了曲谱，轻轻哼了起来。
reply_en: He recognized the score and began to hum.
answers_zh: 她喜欢旧演出票、手写日期和黑白照片。可以有一点亮色，像舞台刚亮起来。
返场时大家一起打拍子，鼓手却慢了半拍，自己也笑了。我想把这种小失误带来的快乐留给她。
answers_en: She loves old gig tickets, handwritten dates and black-and-white photos, with a flash of stage-light colour.
During the encore everyone clapped along. The drummer missed half a beat and laughed. That small, happy imperfection is what I want her to feel.

request_en: I broke my roommate's cup. Help me apologize honestly, without excuses.
reply_zh: 室友说，下周一起去挑一只新的吧。
reply_en: Her roommate suggested choosing a new cup together next week.
answers_zh: 她喜欢简单的东西。白纸、蓝色的笔迹就够了，别把道歉包装得太漂亮。
杯子上有她自己画的一条歪鱼。我找到了同款空白杯，想邀请她一起重新画一个，不是装作旧杯没坏。
answers_en: She likes simple things. White paper and blue ink are enough. I do not want the apology to look like wrapping paper.
She painted a crooked fish on that cup. I found the same blank mug and want to paint a new one together, without pretending the old one was never broken.

他昨天终于找到一直想看的那本书，走出店门又折回来，只为了告诉我第一页就很好笑。
answers_en: He cuts out favourite words to use as bookmarks. Bright colours and a few large letters would make a note worth keeping in a book.
Yesterday he found the book he had been looking for. He came back through the door just to tell me the first page was already funny.

reply_en: He noticed your little drawing and studied it for a long time.
answers_zh: 她偏爱朴素的纸，偶尔在角落画一条线。请给她留些空白，让她自己添。
我回来时，桌上的布头被她按大小叠好了。她还留了张字条，说最小的一块可以给玩偶做口袋。
answers_en: She likes plain paper with a small doodle in a corner. Leave some space so she can add her own marks.
When I returned, she had sorted the fabric scraps by size. A note said the smallest piece would make a pocket for a doll.

request_zh: 做一封邻里野餐邀请。带一点广告传单的活泼感，别像催人消费。
request_en: Invite the neighbors to a picnic. Lively like a flyer, without a sales pitch.
reply_zh: 邀请信贴出去后，有人写上了自己会带的菜。
reply_en: Neighbors began adding the dishes they would bring beneath the invitation.
answers_zh: 大家都不一样，所以做得活泼一点吧。像贴在街角的邀请，不用像商店打折广告。
上次野餐，每个人都说只带一点，最后却铺满了三块桌布。这次记得写：杯子要自己带。
answers_en: Everyone has different tastes, so make it lively, like a street-corner invitation rather than a sale flyer.
Last time everyone promised to bring only a little food and we filled three tablecloths. This time please remind them to bring their own cups.

request_zh: 给离家的姐姐报平安。放一张小镇照片，告诉她日子照常过。
request_en: Write to my sister away from home. Include a town photo and a sense of daily life.
reply_zh: 姐姐回信说，她一眼就认出了那条路。
reply_en: Her sister wrote back that she recognized the street at once.
answers_zh: 姐姐喜欢旧照片和蓝色格子，字会写得很密。你可以留一小块空白，我再补一句。
她总问街口的猫还在不在。昨天它又睡在那张椅子上了，谁坐过去，它就往旁边挪一点。
answers_en: My sister likes old photos and blue checks. She writes closely spaced notes. Leave a little room for one last sentence from me.
She always asks about the cat on our street. Yesterday it was asleep on the same chair, shifting over a little whenever someone sat down.

request_zh: 谢谢借给我工具的朋友。做得利落一点，可以有字母拼贴。
request_en: Thank a friend for lending tools. Keep it simple; letter cutouts are welcome.
reply_zh: 他把这封信摆在工具箱旁边，没舍得收起来。
reply_en: He left the letter beside his toolbox where he could see it.
answers_zh: 他喜欢直接一点，也很爱把不同的字母拼在一起。做得像一句随手留下的谢谢，就很好。
那天修到一半缺一把扳手，他从店门口递过来，顺便给我带了午饭。工具已经擦干净还回去了。
answers_en: He likes direct words and mismatched cutout letters. A casual, thoughtful thank-you will suit him.
I was halfway through a repair when I needed a wrench. He arrived with one and lunch. I have already cleaned and returned the tools.

request_zh: 给明天接班的同事留封信。无需煽情，写一点日常的提醒和善意。
request_en: A note for tomorrow's shift. Small reminders and kindness, without drama.
reply_zh: 第二天，同事在桌上留了一杯还热着的茶。
reply_en: The next morning, a cup of warm tea was waiting on the desk.
answers_zh: 接班的人喜欢看一眼就懂的字条。浅色纸配几块小标签，事情分开写，别挤在一起。
门口第二把伞有点漏水，茶罐在最上层。还有，傍晚那位总来问路的客人，其实是来和大家打招呼的。
answers_en: The next carrier likes notes that can be understood at a glance. Pale paper and a few small labels will help keep things separate.
The second umbrella by the door leaks. The tea is on the top shelf. And the regular who asks directions every evening is really stopping by to say hello.
